title: ClipboardEvent v1
description: Transport-independent clipboard event envelope. Travels device-to-device over the LAN data plane. MUST NOT be accepted or stored by the control plane.

version.description: Protocol version. A receiver MUST reject any value it does not explicitly support.

eventId.description: Globally unique per event. Basis of receiver-side deduplication.

sessionId.description: Null for personal-sync (own devices). Non-null binds the event to an explicit share session.

sequence.description: Per-sender monotonically increasing. Ordering authority; wall clock is informational only.

createdAt.description: Informational. MUST NOT be the sole ordering mechanism. Pattern is duplicated alongside `format` deliberately: `format` is an optional JSON Schema feature, and a validator that ignores it must still reject a malformed timestamp.

contentType.description: MVP content types. Anything else MUST be rejected.

size.description: Declared decoded payload size in bytes. MUST equal the actual decoded size.

hash.description: sha256 of the normalized decoded payload, lowercase hex, algorithm-prefixed.

payload.description: text/plain: the UTF-8 text. image/*: base64 of the image bytes.
